theorem closed_restricted_eq {X Y : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y]
  [LinearOrder Y] [OrderTopology Y] {s : Set X} {f g : X → Y}
  (hs : IsClosed s) (hf : Continuous f) (hg : Continuous g) :
  IsClosed {x | x ∈ s ∧ f x = g x} := by
  have h_le1 : IsClosed {x | f x ≤ g x} := isClosed_le hf hg
  have h_le2 : IsClosed {x | g x ≤ f x} := isClosed_le hg hf
  have h_eq : IsClosed {x | f x = g x} := by
    have h : {x | f x = g x} = {x | f x ≤ g x} ∩ {x | g x ≤ f x} := by
      ext x
      simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_inter_iff, le_antisymm_iff]
    rw [h]
    exact h_le1.inter h_le2
  have h_inter : {x | x ∈ s ∧ f x = g x} = s ∩ {x | f x = g x} := by
    ext x
    simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_inter_iff]
  rw [h_inter]
  exact hs.inter h_eq

    apply Set.ext
    intro x
    simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_inter_iff]
    <;>
    tauto

  have h_main : IsClosed {x : X | x ∈ s ∧ f x = g x} := by
    rw [h_eq]
    exact h_inter_closed
  
  exact h_main
